subject: ✅ Leave Request Approved — $start_date to $end_date
body:
Dear $staff_name,

Your leave request has been APPROVED. The details below have been recorded against your balance — please update your calendar and out-of-office settings.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
LEAVE DETAILS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Request ID:        $request_id
Leave Type:        $leave_type
Start Date:        $start_date
End Date:          $end_date
Working Days:      $total_days
Approved By:       $approver
Approved On:       $approved_on
Remaining Balance: $remaining_days days

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

BEFORE YOU GO

  • Hand off any time-critical work to a named colleague.
  • Set an out-of-office message including your return date.
  • Update shared calendars and any rota you sit on.
  • Check whether any deadlines fall during your leave and replan if needed.

Have a good break — see you when you're back.

Kind regards,
Human Resources
